## Change and evidence

Explain the concrete change and link its engineering issue or product work record. For game data, name the edition, scope and sources. State which checks ran and any remaining limitations.

## Review

- [ ] Candidate files and outgoing commits were reviewed for credentials, private information and source permissions before public publication.
- [ ] Local pre-publication checks and the relevant tests passed for the submitted commit.
- [ ] Any workflow, tool, schema, dependency or input-policy changes are identified for separate engineering review.
- [ ] Test fixtures remain separate from collected catalog data and semantic work items.

Record the reviewed commit and candidate digest if useful; keep local reports, raw captures and private review notes outside this PR.
